players.product: Recursion OS, biological foundation models, and Lab-in-the-Loop drug engine

quarterly_data.signal: CEO Najat Khan: Recursion has 'just crossed over $525 million in upfront and milestones' from its partnerships, of which $125 million is milestones (CFO Ben Taylor: over a dozen milestones hit); she said Recursion has one of the highest milestone totals achieved among AI-native drug discovery companies - 'upfront is promise, milestones is proof'. She said Recursion's small-molecule timelines are about 3x faster than industry and it physically makes about 90% fewer molecules; Ben Taylor said Recursion has had more than a dozen different development candidates, with external partners validating the output. The cost base is down about 40% pro forma after the Exscientia integration.
quarterly_data.figure: over $525 million in upfront and milestones, $125 million of it milestones; timelines about 3x faster; about 90% fewer molecules

quarterly_data.signal: REC-4881 (FAP), CEO Najat Khan: the asset has Orphan Drug Designation and Fast Track designation; Recursion's base case in its FDA conversations is an 'ERAS-like progression-free survival' endpoint built on meaningful clinical events such as surgeries and dysplasia. Additional phase II data will be presented at a presidential plenary at the CGA-IGCC meeting in early November. Over 85% of treatment-related AEs so far are grade 1/2, mainly dermatitis (managed proactively with prophylaxis) and transient CPK changes. REC-4881 is dosed once daily (QD) and Recursion will also look at intermittent dosing given the durability seen off drug. She called it the only investigational asset to date showing rapid, durable polyp reduction including in the upper GI; the TAM is over $10 billion.
quarterly_data.figure: over 85% of treatment-related AEs grade 1/2; Orphan Drug and Fast Track designations; TAM over $10 billion

quarterly_data.signal: Pipeline, CEO Najat Khan: Recursion 'just initiated our PI3K alpha H1047R program at phase I' and has IND-enabling programs in NPP1 and LSD; all of these programs have a catalyst in the next year to 18 months. For REC-1245, RBM39 emerged from knock-out maps as a non-obvious entry point to CDK12 biology and Recursion designed a novel degrader within 18 months; it targets genomically unstable solid tumors and pediatric transcriptionally driven tumors such as Ewing sarcoma, as monotherapy or in combination (e.g. PARP, PRMT5), with an addressable population of about 100,000 patients; more data comes later this year.
quarterly_data.figure: degrader designed within 18 months; about 100,000 addressable patients (REC-1245)

quarterly_data.signal: CEO Najat Khan on China competition: after visiting Shanghai two weeks earlier she found China's speed and execution in optimizing known biology 'really impressive', reflected in the deals done to date, but said the next frontier is novel biology and first-in-class targets, which reinforces Recursion's focus. On policy, she said FDA regulatory guidance matters most at Recursion's stage, with MFN and other pricing policies critical to the commercial potential of its assets.

connects_to.relationship: AI-discovered neuroscience targets and joint drug discovery

contracts.signal: CEO Najat Khan: Recursion has a 10-year exclusive neuroscience partnership with Roche, and the whole-genome CRISPR knockout neuroscience maps are exclusive to Roche; Recursion is now developing the small molecule for the first optioned target and expects potential for more targets from the same data set. CFO Ben Taylor: Recursion owns all of the data - Roche only has access to the work product - and there is 'another five years on the partnership', which Recursion hopes to continue.
contracts.units: exclusive neuroscience maps; first optioned target in small-molecule development
contracts.type: AI target-discovery collaboration - exclusivity and data ownership

contracts.signal: CEO Najat Khan: the Sanofi collaboration develops small molecules, including degraders, against intractable first-in-class I&I and oncology targets; the five milestones achieved so far are for lead series. The next guided milestone is at development candidate for a first-in-class oral small-molecule program; once Sanofi options it, the program enters Sanofi's pipeline and Recursion no longer carries operating costs. She put Sanofi milestones at over $300 million with 'teen level royalties'.
contracts.units: five lead-series milestones; next: first development candidate
contracts.value: milestones over $300 million; teen level royalties
